meta.title: cloud3 — Watch. Read. Listen.
meta.desc: cloud3 is an open-source Android player for films, series and manga. Download the latest build, look inside the app, and put a record on.
meta.ogAlt: cloud3 — the Android app for films, series and manga

hero.title: Watch. Read.
hero.lead: One player for your films, series and manga. You choose the sources; cloud3 keeps everything else quiet.
hero.alt: Yoru from Chainsaw Man, black hair and a scarred face, lifting the hem of a dark sweatshirt

features.title: Your library, not a content store
features.lead: cloud3 ships empty by design. Add the sources you trust and they appear across search and browse.

items.title: Films and series
items.line: Install any CloudStream-compatible extension and its sources show up in search and browse.

items.title: Manga, kept separate
items.line: Mihon-compatible extensions get their own shelves, categories and reading history.

items.title: Arabic throughout
items.line: A true right-to-left interface, with Arabic titles set correctly and Latin digits kept consistent.

items.title: Open and ad-free
items.line: GPL-3.0, no account, no tracking. Every official build is compiled in public by GitHub Actions.

items.a: Yes. It is free, with no ads and no account. Donations are welcome but never required, and nothing is locked behind them.

items.q: Does it include films, series or manga?
items.a: No. cloud3 arrives empty, with no content and no sources. What you watch or read comes from extensions you install yourself.
Open the extensions screen, add the repository URL, then install the sources you want. They appear in search and browse straight away.
Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. It is designed for phones and adapts to tablets.
Yes, under GPL v3. The code is on GitHub, and every official build is produced there by GitHub Actions.

sections.p: cloud3 is a player and a library. The app contains no films, series, manga, channels or providers, and this site hosts none of them. Everything you watch or read comes from external extensions you choose and install yourself.

The extensions and the sources they point at are written and maintained by other people. cloud3 does not control them, does not review what they show, and cannot vouch for their legality where you live. You are responsible for what you add and for following the laws that apply to you.

The project is not affiliated with CloudStream, Mihon, Keiyoushi, Nuvio, Google, or any content provider, studio or streaming service. Names are mentioned only to identify the origin of code or the extension format.
cloud3 is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You may use, study, modify and share it under the same license. The full text is in the LICENSE file in the repository.
Keep the project open source. Keep the attribution. State your changes clearly. And please do not sell the app or a build of it.

cloud3 builds on open-source work: CloudStream for the extension system, Nuvio for the cinematic interface (GPL-3.0), and Mihon for the manga compatibility layer (Apache-2.0). The NOTICE file lists every ported file.
Questions about any of this belong in the Telegram channel.

The Yoru artwork at the top of the page is fan art of a Chainsaw Man character, and its rights belong to their owners. It is not part of cloud3 and implies no affiliation. The record artwork and audio files come from the bundled Vinyl project.
